title: GoodMC
description: A small optimization and improvements mod for minecraft. Now with BareBones!
body:
### GoodMC
GoodMC is a lightweight modpack focused on providing optimization and qol fixes to the game to make it more playable and fun for everyone. It also includes barebones as a texture pack if you want to use it in your world. Among others there are mods like simple voice chat, do a barrel roll, and sodium
